$comment: Root ADR-0348. How 국토교통부 실거래가 (data.go.kr RTMS OpenAPI, the only automated channel: rt.molit.go.kr forbids automated access) is asked, what an answer must look like, and the call bounds. Read by collect-data-go-kr-rtms (services/foundation-outbox-publisher/src/data_go_kr_rtms_collect.rs, compiled in) and by the Silver load (infra/lakehouse/spark/jobs/data_go_kr_rtms.py).
request_spacing_reason: The gateway allows 35 requests a second (X-RateLimit-Limit on its 429, measured 2026-10-30) and four parallel workers drew 429 for about a minute; one request at a time every 250 ms (4 a second) leaves the rest of the second for the key's other collectors.

result_codes.$comment: response.header.resultCode. The RTMS services answer 000 (an empty month is 000 with totalCount 0); 00 is the portal's older spelling. Anything else fails the run.

per_run_reason: Root ADR-0300 H: measured 2026-10-30 about 0.55 s a request with the spacing, so 3,000 calls are about 28 minutes, inside run_time_budget_seconds and the job's 40-minute limit. Hourly that is 72,000 calls a day: the history (about 820,000 calls, computed: 269 시군구 x (8 trade datasets x ~250 months + 4 rent datasets x ~190 months) plus extra pages) lands in about 12 days; the steady refresh is about 15,600 calls a day (computed from refresh_tiers).
daily_call_limit_reason: Our own bound per dataset and KST day, a fifth of the gateway's 1,000,000 (X-RateLimit-Limit on a 200, measured 2026-10-30).

refresh_tiers.reason: this month and the two before: reports arrive within 30 days of the contract, and 31% of cancellations come within 30 days
cancellations: p99 354 days after the contract (810 measured, root ADR-0348 Context)
the latest measured cancellation came 442 days after the contract

silver_load.$comment: What one Silver load takes (plan-silver-load-objects): the Bronze objects no commit of silver.real_transaction records, within window_days, at most max_objects a load.
silver_load.max_unmasked_unresolved_share_reason: Root ADR-0349 §6: of the rows whose lot the provider did not mask, the share that found no current parcel; above it a load lands its rows and fails so it is seen. Measured 2026-10-30 before any load (API 2025-09, 12 random 시군구, read-only Trino against silver.parcel_boundaries current rows): 4,925 unmasked candidates of 공장창고·상업업무·아파트·연립·오피스텔, 99.7% a current parcel. History rows meet more re-numbered lots, so the bound leaves room; the pull request that records the first loads sets it from them.
